const a = $('Restore Application').first().json; const role = $('Check Job Open').first().json.jobRole || 'the position'; const TEAM = 'The Hiring Team'; const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c])); const firstName = esc(String(a.name ?? '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'Applicant'); const html = `
👋

Welcome, ${firstName}!

Thank you for your application

Hi ${firstName},

Thank you for your interest in the ${esc(role)} position, and for taking the time to apply. We're glad you've considered this opportunity!

Your application has been received, and we're excited to learn more about you.

What happens next
📄 We review your CV and match it to the role.
📧 If it's a good fit, we'll email you an invitation to book an interview.
🤝 Either way, you'll hear back from us.
Your reference ID: ${esc(a.applicationId)}

Please keep an eye on your inbox (and your spam folder, just in case). There's no need to apply again.

Warm regards,
${esc(TEAM)}

You received this email because you submitted an application for a position.
We use automated tools to help screen applications, and our team makes the final decisions.
`; return [{ json: { to: a.email, subject: `We received your application for ${String(role).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ')}`, html } }];
